module purpose: neorv32_twi takes control settings (enable, prescaler selection, clock divider, clock-stretch enable) and 11-bit command words from bus writes, queues the commands in a TX FIFO sub-unit, and runs an engine that, paced by a divided tick and a four-phase sequence, drives the SDA and SCL output lines for each command (two line-condition sequences and a 9-bit shift), samples the SDA and SCL inputs, pushes each shifted-in 9-bit word into an RX FIFO sub-unit for bus reads, returns settings and status on control reads, exports the enable on clkgen_en_o and raises irq_o when enabled, idle and the TX FIFO is empty.

use-case flows.value: control settings (enable, prescaler selection, clock divider, clock-stretch enable) written from the bus data word into ctrl on a write to the control address, and the enable exported on clkgen_en_o
an 11-bit command word (data bits 7-0, bit 8, command bits 10-9) pushed into the TX FIFO by a bus write to the data address and dispatched to the idle engine when a command is available on a tick
bit tick: the counter advances when the clkgen_i bit selected by ctrl.prsc is '1' and the tick fires when it equals ctrl.cdiv
four-phase sequence within a bit, rotated on each tick unless the clock-stretch halt decision is '1', and the phase pulses derived from it
engine transfer: the state-selected line sequences on SDA and SCL, the 9-bit shift out and in, bit counting and completion, with the line inputs synchronized
interrupt request (enabled, TX FIFO empty, engine idle) and status bits (sensed SCL and SDA, TX full, RX available, busy) returned on a control read
received 9-bit word pushed into the RX FIFO on completion and returned and popped on a bus read of the data address; control settings and FIFO size returned on a control read
rstn_i low clears ctrl.enable, ctrl.prsc, ctrl.cdiv, irq_o, the tick counter, the phase registers, the engine registers and the line samplers, and sets both line drive registers to '1'
ctrl.enable at '0' clears both FIFOs, holds the tick counter and tick at zero, forces the phase register to 0001 and clears engine state bit 2
